hypothesis: The severe-loss model fails after stage-1 conditioning because it is optimized for the full pullback population. Adding causal stage-1 value context and emphasizing shortlist-like pullbacks during training should restore risk ordering inside the stage-1 domain.
compared_models: global support plus stage1 value context and 4x shortlist emphasis
nested_causality: Within each outer fold, stage2 training shortlist emphasis for each training day is generated by a stage1 model fit only on the other two outer-training days. The outer held-out day is never used.
forbidden: using outer held-out labels for stage2 training emphasis
next_if_pass: Build causal ENTER/WAIT/REJECT recheck using the adapted conditioned-risk state.
next_if_fail: Measure whether outcome separability improves after observing additional post-pullback states before building a recurrent action policy.
